def reference_attention_mask(image_tokens, text_len, ref_tokens, device, dtype, ref_query_mask, ref_allow_text=True, context_vision_mask=None, query_ref_tokens=0, image_to_text_mask=None, text_attention_mask=None, text_to_ref_mask=None, mask_text_self_attention=False, dit_text_mask=None):
    """Restrict reference keys without isolating target regions from each other."""
    if ref_query_mask is None:
        ref_query_mask = torch.ones((1, image_tokens), dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
    allowed = ref_query_mask.to(device=device).reshape(-1, image_tokens)
    bias = torch.zeros(allowed.shape, device=device, dtype=dtype).masked_fill(~allowed, -torch.inf) if allowed.dtype == torch.bool else allowed.to(dtype=dtype)
    nq = image_tokens + text_len + query_ref_tokens
    mask = torch.zeros((bias.shape[0], 1, nq, image_tokens + text_len + ref_tokens), device=device, dtype=dtype)
    mask[:, 0, :image_tokens, image_tokens + text_len:] = bias.unsqueeze(-1)
    if not ref_allow_text:
        mask[:, :, image_tokens:image_tokens + text_len, image_tokens + text_len:] = -torch.inf
    elif text_to_ref_mask is not None:
        scope = text_to_ref_mask.to(device=device)
        if scope.ndim != 2 or scope.shape[-1] != text_len:
            raise ValueError("Text-to-reference mask does not match context")
        scope = torch.zeros_like(scope, dtype=dtype).masked_fill(~scope, -torch.inf) if scope.dtype == torch.bool else scope.to(dtype=dtype)
        mask[:, 0, image_tokens:image_tokens + text_len, image_tokens + text_len:] = scope.unsqueeze(-1)
    if context_vision_mask is not None:
        blocked = torch.isneginf(bias).unsqueeze(-1) & context_vision_mask.to(device=device, dtype=torch.bool).reshape(-1, 1, text_len)
        mask[:, 0, :image_tokens, image_tokens:image_tokens + text_len].masked_fill_(blocked, -torch.inf)
    if image_to_text_mask is not None:
        scope = image_to_text_mask.to(device=device)
        if scope.shape[-2:] != (image_tokens, text_len):
            raise ValueError("Image-to-text mask does not match canvas/context")
        scope = torch.zeros_like(scope, dtype=dtype).masked_fill(~scope, -torch.inf) if scope.dtype == torch.bool else scope.to(dtype=dtype)
        mask[:, 0, :image_tokens, image_tokens:image_tokens + text_len] += scope
    dit_scope = dit_text_mask if dit_text_mask is not None else (text_attention_mask if mask_text_self_attention else None)
    if dit_scope is not None:
        scope = dit_scope.to(device=device)
        if scope.shape[-2:] != (text_len, text_len):
            raise ValueError("Text attention mask does not match context")
        scope = torch.zeros_like(scope, dtype=dtype).masked_fill(~scope, -torch.inf) if scope.dtype == torch.bool else scope.to(dtype=dtype)
        mask[:, 0, image_tokens:image_tokens + text_len, image_tokens:image_tokens + text_len] += scope
    return mask
